senses.gloss: (<cite ref="A00729"><he>אוֹנוּ</he></cite>) <he>אוֹנִית</he> f. = <cite ref="A00735"><he>אוֹנָה</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="A00745"><he>אוֹנִיתָא</he></cite>. [The phonetic coïncidence with ὠνή produced the peculiar use of our w. in connection with Greek terms, in the Palest. literature.] <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 2:2">Gen. R. s. 2</cite> beg. <he>בא׳ אחת ובטימי וכ׳</he> in one bill of sale and for the same price.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:9:7">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיסתיוסיס בא׳ היא וכ׳</he> (read <he>מיסתוס׳</he>) it is a lease with a title of possession (for the term), and is (for the time being) an acquisition like a purchase.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:7">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> (<cite ref="A00735"><he>אוני</he></cite> a. <he>אונו</he>); a. e.—Pl. <he>אוֹנִיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:22">Gen. R. s. 84</cite>, end <he>כמה א׳ וכ׳</he> how many deeds were written for him (how many times was he sold)?, cmp. <cite ref="A00717"><he>אוֹן</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 34:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 24</cite>; Pesik. Rosh. Hash. p. 151ᵃ, v. <cite ref="A00740"><he>אוֹנָיָה</he></cite>.]
